privacy.metaDescription: Privacy policy of the Nirby service
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.s1Body: Théo Brissiaud, a natural person, is the controller of personal data for the Nirby service (https://nirby.theobrissiaud.fr). This is a personal project, with no company.
privacy.s2Body: Account: email address, hashed password, display name, bio, avatar URL. Content you create: lists, places (name, notes, coordinates, photos), collaboration roles. Technical data: sessions, refresh cookie, language preference. Transactional emails (verification, password reset, invite, deletion confirmation). Place-search queries sent to Google Places. If you consent: technical error data sent to Sentry (page, browser, stack trace).
privacy.s3Body: Providing the Nirby service (account, lists, map, sharing), authenticating users, sending account emails, security, displaying the map, and offering place search.
privacy.s4Body: Performance of the service: account, lists, map, transactional emails. Legitimate interest: security, abuse prevention, and server-side Sentry (infrastructure errors, no browser cookie). Consent: the Sentry SDK in the browser (cookie banner, revocable from the profile).
privacy.s5Body: Account data, lists and media: until the account is deleted. Access token: 15 minutes. refreshToken cookie: 7 days. Email verification token: 24 hours. Password-reset token: 1 hour. Google Places cache: 30 days. Cookie choice (localStorage): until you change it or clear the browser.
privacy.s6Body: The following providers process data to run Nirby:
privacy.s6Ovh: Application hosting (site, API, PostgreSQL, Redis): OVH SAS, 2 rue Kellermann, 59100 Roubaix, France. Servers in Gravelines (GRA), France.
privacy.s6Aws: Files (avatars, photos): Amazon Web Services, S3 storage, region eu-west-3 (Paris), direct access.
privacy.s6Google: Place search and place details: Google Places, called only through the Nirby API.
privacy.s6Sentry: Error diagnostics: Sentry (sentry.io). In the browser only with your consent.
privacy.s6Transfers: Resend, Mapbox, Google and Sentry are established outside the EU (United States). Some data may therefore leave the EU, limited to what these services require.
privacy.s7Body: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection where provided by the GDPR, portability, and a complaint to the CNIL (<cnil>cnil.fr</cnil>). To exercise your rights: use the contact in section 1.
privacy.s7Product: In the app: edit your profile; download a JSON export of your data (Profile → Privacy); delete your account, which cascades to lists and places you own.
privacy.s8Body: Hashed passwords, httpOnly session cookie, HTTPS in production, API input validation. No audience measurement, no advertising.
privacy.s9Body: Nirby uses strictly necessary cookies to run the service. Optional error monitoring is loaded only with your consent. You can change this choice at any time from your profile (Privacy).
privacy.s9Necessary: Strictly necessary (no prior consent): the httpOnly refreshToken cookie (authentication, SameSite=strict); the NEXT_LOCALE cookie (language preference, 1 year, SameSite=lax). Display theme is stored in localStorage (next-themes) and is not a tracker.
privacy.s9Mapbox: Mapbox GL loads map tiles required for the product. It is not gated by the consent banner: refusing it would break the map. Google Places is called only through the Nirby API; the browser does not set a Google cookie for place search.
privacy.s9Sentry: Optional: the Sentry client SDK (error telemetry). It is initialised only if you accept it in the cookie banner. Server-side Sentry does not set a browser cookie.
